content: ModeSwitchPoint The ModeSwitchPoint also allows for the definition of a ModeSwitchedAckEvent if this is requested by the definition of the PPortPrototype . This RTEEvent is eventually owned by a mode manager to allow for getting confirmation of a mode change.
